passages.title: 송년회 장소 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Events Committee
To: All Staff
Subject: Year-End Party Details

Dear colleagues,

Our year-end party will be held on Friday, December 19, at the Riverside Grand Hall, starting at 6:30 p.m. Dinner, games, and a prize drawing are planned.

Family members are welcome; please add their names when you sign up by December 10. Buses will leave from the office at 6 p.m. sharp.

Events Committee

questions.q: What is the email about?
questions.exKo: 12월 19일 송년회 세부 사항을 알리는 메일입니다.

questions.q: What should staff do by December 10?
choices: Sign up with family members' names
questions.exKo: 12월 10일까지 가족 이름을 포함해 신청하라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: When do the buses leave the office?
questions.exKo: Buses will leave from the office at 6 p.m. sharp에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 인터넷 요금제 변경 확인 메일
passages.passage:
From: FastNet Internet
To: Olivia Grant
Subject: Plan Change Confirmed

Dear Ms. Grant,

Your internet plan has been changed from Basic to Premium, effective today. Your new monthly charge is $45, starting with next month's bill.

Premium gives you twice the speed and a free security package. Your router does not need to be replaced. If you did not request this change, call us within 7 days.

FastNet Billing Team

questions.q: What does the email confirm?
questions.exKo: 요금제가 Basic에서 Premium으로 변경되었음을 확인하는 메일입니다.

questions.q: What is included with Premium?
choices: Twice the speed and a free security package
questions.exKo: twice the speed and a free security package라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What should Ms. Grant do if she did not request the change?
questions.exKo: call us within 7 days라고 안내되어 있습니다.

passages.title: 사내 독감 예방접종 공지
passages.passage:
FLU SHOT NOTICE

Free flu shots will be offered to all employees on Tuesday, October 8, in the health room next to the cafeteria. No appointment is needed; just bring your employee card.

Hours are 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., closed for lunch from 12 to 1. The shot takes about five minutes, and nurses ask you to rest for ten minutes afterward.

Health & Safety Team

questions.q: What is being offered on October 8?
questions.exKo: 10월 8일 전 직원 대상 무료 독감 예방접종 안내입니다.

questions.q: What should employees bring?
questions.exKo: just bring your employee card라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What are employees asked to do after the shot?
questions.exKo: rest for ten minutes afterward라고 요청합니다.

passages.title: 도서 대여 코너 신설 공지
passages.passage:
NEW BOOK CORNER

A small lending library has opened in the 5th-floor lounge. Take any book freely and return it within one month. To donate books, place them in the box marked 'Donations.'

The corner starts with 150 books, including novels, business titles, and travel guides. A list of all books is posted on the company intranet. Happy reading!

Culture Committee

questions.q: What has opened in the lounge?
questions.exKo: 5층 라운지에 도서 대여 코너가 생겼다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: How long can a book be borrowed?
questions.exKo: return it within one month라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: Where can people see the full book list?
questions.exKo: A list of all books is posted on the company intranet에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 겨울 타이어 교체 광고
passages.passage:
WINTER IS COMING — IS YOUR CAR READY?

At Summit Auto Center, get winter tires installed from $240 for a set of four, including balancing and a free brake check.

Book online and skip the line: most installations take under 40 minutes. We store your summer tires for $8 a month. Offer runs through November 30.

questions.q: What is the advertisement mainly for?
questions.exKo: 겨울용 타이어 장착 서비스를 홍보하는 광고입니다.

questions.q: What is included in the $240 price?
choices: Balancing and a free brake check
questions.exKo: including balancing and a free brake check라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: How much does tire storage cost?
questions.exKo: store your summer tires for $8 a month에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 주말 브런치 뷔페 광고
passages.passage:
WEEKEND BRUNCH AT THE GARDEN TABLE

Join us every Saturday and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. for our brunch buffet. Enjoy fresh salads, eggs made to order, and twenty kinds of dessert.

Adults $22, children under 10 half price. Book a window seat early — they go fast! Reservations by phone only. Free parking behind the restaurant.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.exKo: 주말 브런치 뷔페를 홍보하는 광고입니다.

questions.q: How much do children under 10 pay?
questions.exKo: children under 10 half price라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How can customers make a reservation?
questions.exKo: Reservations by phone only에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 중앙역 안내 로봇 시범 운영 기사
passages.passage:
CENTRAL CITY — A friendly guide robot named Milo began working at Central Station this week. Milo answers questions about train times, platforms, and nearby buses in four languages.

During the three-month trial, staff will watch how travelers use the robot. Early feedback is positive, though some older passengers still prefer the information desk, which will stay open as usual.

questions.q: What is the article about?
choices: A trial of a station guide robot
questions.exKo: 중앙역에서 안내 로봇 Milo가 시범 운영된다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: What can Milo do?
choices: Answer travel questions in four languages
questions.exKo: 열차 시간, 승강장, 버스 정보를 4개 언어로 안내합니다.

questions.q: What is stated about the information desk?
choices: It will stay open as usual
questions.exKo: the information desk, which will stay open as usual에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 사내 텃밭 프로그램 기사
passages.passage:
LAKESIDE — Insurance firm Harbor Mutual turned its roof into a vegetable garden this spring. Forty employees signed up to care for tomato, lettuce, and herb beds during lunch breaks.

The harvest goes to the staff cafeteria, cutting its vegetable costs. "Ten minutes of gardening clears my head better than coffee," said accountant Lisa Cho. The company will add ten more garden beds next year.

questions.q: What did Harbor Mutual do?
choices: Turned its roof into a vegetable garden
questions.exKo: 보험사가 옥상을 채소 텃밭으로 바꿨다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: Where does the harvest go?
questions.exKo: The harvest goes to the staff cafeteria라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What is planned for next year?
questions.exKo: add ten more garden beds next year에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 공항 마중 확인 문자
passages.passage:
Hana Sato (7:15 A.M.)
Good morning! I've landed at Gate 12. Where should I go?

Driver Kim (7:16 A.M.)
Welcome! I'm waiting at Exit 3, holding a sign with your name. I'm wearing a blue cap.

Hana Sato (7:18 A.M.)
Got it. I need about 15 minutes to pick up my suitcase.

Driver Kim (7:19 A.M.)
No problem. Traffic to your hotel is light — about 25 minutes. Take your time.

questions.q: Where is Driver Kim waiting?
questions.exKo: waiting at Exit 3, holding a sign이라고 안내합니다.
why: 'waiting at Exit 3'가 기사의 대기 장소를 그대로 명시
Gate 12는 Sato가 도착한 곳 — 단어 반복 함정
호텔은 이동할 목적지이지 대기 장소가 아님
주차장에서 기다린다는 언급이 지문에 없음
questions.ev: I'm waiting at Exit 3, holding a sign with your name.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Sato need 15 minutes?
questions.exKo: pick up my suitcase에서 이유를 알 수 있습니다.
why: 'to pick up my suitcase'가 15분이 필요한 이유
표를 산다는 언급이 지문에 없음
Exit 3은 만날 장소일 뿐 — 단어 반복 함정
전화를 건다는 언급이 지문에 없음
questions.ev: I need about 15 minutes to pick up my suitcase.

questions.q: How long is the drive to the hotel?
questions.exKo: Traffic ... about 25 minutes라고 알려 줍니다.
why: 'about 25 minutes'가 호텔까지 소요 시간
15분은 짐 찾는 시간 — 다른 문항의 정답
한 시간이 걸린다는 언급이 지문에 없음
5분이라는 시간은 지문에 언급 없음
questions.ev: Traffic to your hotel is light — about 25 minutes.

passages.title: 재고 라벨 프린터 대여 문자
passages.passage:
Gary Lin (3:20 P.M.)
Hi Wendy, our label printer died in the middle of inventory. Does your team have one we could borrow today?

Wendy Cruz (3:23 P.M.)
Yes, we have a spare. You can pick it up from our storage on the 2nd floor.

Gary Lin (3:24 P.M.)
Lifesaver! We'll return it by Thursday.

Wendy Cruz (3:25 P.M.)
No rush. Ask for Danny — he'll sign it out for you.

questions.q: Why does Mr. Lin contact Ms. Cruz?
questions.exKo: 재고 조사 중 라벨 프린터가 고장 나 빌리려는 것입니다.
why: 프린터 고장으로 'borrow'를 요청하는 것이 목적
고장 난 것은 프린터이지 창고가 아님
재고 조사는 자기 팀 상황이지 도움 제안 아님
Danny는 대여 처리 담당 — 다른 문항의 정답
questions.ev: our label printer died in the middle of inventory. Does your team have one we could borrow today?

questions.q: Where is the spare printer?
questions.exKo: pick it up from our storage on the 2nd floor라고 안내합니다.
why: 'storage on the 2nd floor'가 여분 프린터 보관 장소
Danny는 서명해 줄 사람이지 보관 장소가 아님
재고 조사실이라는 장소는 지문에 언급 없음
2층이라고 했으므로 3층은 지문과 다름
questions.ev: You can pick it up from our storage on the 2nd floor.

questions.q: Who will sign out the printer?
questions.exKo: Ask for Danny — he'll sign it out for you에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'he'll sign it out'의 he가 Danny를 가리킴
Wendy는 대여를 허락하고 안내만 해 줌
Gary는 프린터를 빌리는 쪽이지 처리자 아님
매니저가 서명한다는 언급이 지문에 없음
questions.ev: Ask for Danny — he'll sign it out for you.
